function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now.  

If you need the current local time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s world‑clock feature, or simply look at the time zone offset: New York is usually 4 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC‑4) during daylight‑saving time (Eastern Daylight Time) and 5 hours behind (UTC‑5) during standard time (Eastern Standard Time).  

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
